name: deduction guides for std::valarray

declarations.code:
template <typename T, std::size_t cnt>

valarray(const T (&)[cnt], std::size_t) -> valarray<T>;

intro: This deduction guide is provided for std::valarray to allow deduction from array and size (note that deduction from pointer and size is covered by the implicit guides).
